# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Data Plane - Actions API Reference (Fetched 2026-05-18)

## Complete List of Supported Actions

### Memory Management Actions
- BatchCreateMemoryRecords - Create multiple memory records in batch
- BatchDeleteMemoryRecords - Delete multiple memory records in batch
- BatchUpdateMemoryRecords - Update multiple memory records in batch
- DeleteMemoryRecord - Delete a single memory record
- GetMemoryRecord - Retrieve a specific memory record
- ListMemoryRecords - List all memory records
- ListMemoryExtractionJobs - List memory extraction jobs
- RetrieveMemoryRecords - Retrieve memory records
- StartMemoryExtractionJob - Start a memory extraction job

### Authentication & Token Actions
- CompleteResourceTokenAuth
- GetResourceApiKey
- GetResourceOauth2Token
- GetResourcePaymentToken (NEW since prior scan)
- GetWorkloadAccessToken
- GetWorkloadAccessTokenForJWT
- GetWorkloadAccessTokenForUserId

### Event Management Actions
- CreateEvent
- DeleteEvent
- GetEvent
- ListEvents

### Agent & Runtime Operations
- GetAgentCard
- InvokeAgentRuntime
- InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand
- InvokeHarness (NEW since prior scan)
- StopRuntimeSession

### Browser Session Actions
- GetBrowserSession
- ListBrowserSessions
- SaveBrowserSessionProfile
- StartBrowserSession
- StopBrowserSession
- UpdateBrowserStream
- InvokeBrowser

### Code Interpreter Actions
- GetCodeInterpreterSession
- InvokeCodeInterpreter
- ListCodeInterpreterSessions
- StartCodeInterpreterSession
- StopCodeInterpreterSession

### Registry Actions
- SearchRegistryRecords

### A/B Testing & Recommendation Actions (NEW set since prior scan)
- CreateABTest
- DeleteABTest
- GetABTest
- ListABTests
- UpdateABTest
- DeleteBatchEvaluation
- GetBatchEvaluation
- ListBatchEvaluations
- StartBatchEvaluation
- StopBatchEvaluation
- DeleteRecommendation
- GetRecommendation
- ListRecommendations
- StartRecommendation

### Payments Actions (NEW set since prior scan)
- CreatePaymentInstrument
- CreatePaymentSession
- DeletePaymentInstrument
- DeletePaymentSession
- GetPaymentInstrument
- GetPaymentInstrumentBalance
- GetPaymentSession
- ListPaymentInstruments
- ListPaymentSessions
- ProcessPayment

### Additional Operations
- Evaluate
- ListActors
- ListSessions

Updated: 2026-05-18 — NEW actions detected since previous scan: A/B Testing actions (CreateABTest/DeleteABTest/GetABTest/ListABTests/UpdateABTest), Batch Evaluation actions (Delete/Get/List/Start/StopBatchEvaluation), Recommendation actions (Delete/Get/List/StartRecommendation), Payments actions (CreatePaymentInstrument/Session, Delete/Get/ListPaymentInstrument/Session, GetPaymentInstrumentBalance, ProcessPayment, GetResourcePaymentToken), InvokeHarness, InvokeBrowser.
